A '''[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base''' was located on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Radar-cloaking superweapon]] underwent construction there. The base, along with the weapon, was destroyed by the clone trooper [[Denal/Legends|Denal]].
